description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is a small, low-resolution publisher interface badge: a circular "ring" logo made of two arc segments — a blue arc occupying the upper/right portion and a yellow arc occupying the lower/left portion — surrounding a red, vertically oriented bookmark/ribbon shape with a notched (V-cut) bottom edge, which sits in the centre of the ring. Immediately below the ring, the English words "Check for updates" are printed in two centred lines of dark sans-serif type. The whole graphic is set against a plain white background. There are no axes, no units, no scale bars, no panel letters, no data curves, no spectra, no micrographs, no legends, no tables and no sample or condition labels anywhere in the image. Consequently the image carries no materials-science data and cannot be used to identify an alloy, a processing condition, a phase, a measured quantity or a trend. It is a generic "Check for updates" crossmark-style badge of the kind inserted by publishers to link a paper to its latest version, so it conveys nothing about the fatigue behaviour, κ-carbide precipitation state, or deformation mechanisms of the Fe-30.5Mn-8Al-1C austenitic low-density steel discussed in the paper. The caption field of this figure group was empty ("no caption extracted"), and no citing text block was provided to clarify its intended content. The only recoverable information is the badge text itself.
